Airsoft.subject: Sports
Airsoft.question: The _____ was Type of shooting sport and hobby activity.
Airsoft.fact: Airsoft, also called survival game in Japan, is a shooting sport in which players use airsoft guns to tag opponents with plastic airsoft pellets. Airsoft originated in Japan in the early 1970s from realistic model guns originally developed for target shooting.
